settings.repository.label: Repository
settings.repository.description: Restic repository location, for example /mnt/backup/restic or sftp:host:/srv/restic. Credentials embedded in the URL are hidden in the UI but recommended only for local paths.
settings.password_file.label: Password file
settings.password_file.description: Path to a file holding the repository password. The plugin passes the path to restic and never reads the contents.
settings.env_file.label: Environment file
settings.env_file.description: Optional file sourced by the backup job before restic runs, for backends that need credentials in the environment (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, B2_ACCOUNT_KEY, RCLONE_*).
settings.backup_paths.label: Backup paths
settings.backup_paths.description: Absolute paths to back up. Nothing is backed up until at least one path is set.
settings.backup_tags.label: Backup tags
settings.backup_tags.description: Tags attached to every snapshot this plugin creates.
settings.exclude_file.label: Exclude file
settings.exclude_file.description: Optional restic exclude file applied to every backup.
settings.mode.label: Mode
settings.mode.description: plugin runs its own schedule; observe only watches a repository that something else backs up.
settings.interval_minutes.label: Backup interval (minutes)
settings.interval_minutes.description: How often to run a backup. The schedule is stored on disk, so it survives a shell restart and catches up if a run is missed.
settings.job_timeout_minutes.label: Job timeout (minutes)
settings.job_timeout_minutes.description: A job still running after this long is treated as stuck: it is cancelled and reported instead of blocking the next scheduled run.
settings.check_interval_hours.label: Integrity check interval (hours)
settings.check_interval_hours.descriptio: Run restic check on this interval, reading a rotating subset of the repository data. 0 disables scheduled checks.
settings.stale_after_hours.label: Stale after (hours)
settings.stale_after_hours.description: Warn when the newest snapshot is older than this. 0 derives the threshold from the backup interval.
settings.keep_last.label: Keep last
settings.keep_daily.label: Keep daily
settings.keep_weekly.label: Keep weekly
settings.keep_monthly.label: Keep monthly
settings.restore_target.label: Restore target
settings.restore_target.description: Staging directory for restores. Snapshots are restored beneath it under their original absolute path; nothing is ever restored in place.
settings.restore_allow_roots.label: Additional restore roots
settings.restore_allow_roots.description: Extra directories a restore may target. The restore target above is always allowed; a restore to /, $HOME or a backed-up path is refused.
settings.check_subset.label: Check subset
settings.check_subset.description: restic --read-data-subset value for manual checks, for example 1/100 or 5%.
settings.restic_bin.label: restic binary
settings.widget.show_count.label: Show snapshot count
settings.widget.show_staleness.label: Show staleness
panel.title: Restic Snapshots
panel.empty.snapshots_hint: Configure a repository, then run a backup.
panel.filter.search: Filter by host, tag or path
panel.filter.label: Show
panel.logs.truncated: log truncated to the last {lines} lines
panel.files.truncated: listing truncated to the first {lines} entries
panel.restore.confirm: Restore writes into the staging target only. Confirm to run it.
panel.init.explain: The repository is reachable but has no restic data yet. Initialise it to start backing up.
panel.error.locked: The repository is locked by another restic process. Clear the stale lock if nothing is running.
panel.why.not_configured: Set the repository and password file in the plugin settings.
panel.why.observe: The plugin is in observe mode.
panel.retention.no_policy: Set at least one keep-* rule in the plugin settings.
panel.prune.note: Removal only runs after you confirm below.
panel.prune.truncated: removal list truncated to the first {shown} snapshots
panel.restore.preview_missing: Preview first: no restore preview is loaded for this snapshot.
panel.diff.no_previous: No older snapshot to diff against.
settings.pre_backup_command.label: Command before backup
settings.pre_backup_command.description: Optional shell command run inside the job before restic starts, for example a database dump into a staging directory. A non-zero exit aborts the backup and is reported.
settings.post_backup_command.label: Command after backup
settings.post_backup_command.description: Optional shell command run inside the job after a successful backup. It receives the backup's exit code in RESTIC_EXIT; a failure there is reported but does not mark the backup as failed.
settings.verify_interval_hours.label: Restore verification interval (hours)
settings.verify_interval_hours.descripti: How often to prove a backup can actually be restored: files are restored from the newest snapshot into a scratch directory and compared against the live files. 0 disables it.
settings.verify_file_count.label: Files per verification
settings.verify_file_count.description: How many files the restore check restores and compares each time.
settings.metrics_dir.label: Metrics directory
settings.metrics_dir.description: Optional directory for a Prometheus textfile export (node_exporter's textfile collector): restic_snapshots.prom is rewritten whenever the state changes.
